A whimsical spooky anime cartoon forest at twilight just after a forest fire, sparse blackened crooked trees, lavender drifting low mist, distant mauve hills, a peach last glow of sunset, a few orange leaves caught in the breeze. flee: Using the attached sheet only as CHARACTER DESIGN REFERENCE, create a NEW true-transparent sprite animation sheet of this exact ordinary RED polka-dot clown FLEEING IN PANIC. This is NOT a cheerful walking cycle. Exactly TWELVE full body drawings on a strict FOUR columns by THREE rows equal grid, no labels or ground. THIRD row: four matching panicked running poses with torso still running LEFT but head turned RIGHT to look fearfully BACK over his shoulder; eyes looking right behind him, hands still extended forward LEFT, not reaching backward. Keep identical body size, generous gutters around EVERY full character, no cropped shoes or hands. Anime + richly inked 1930s rubberhose cartoon game art, polished cel shading, warm painted colors, crisp black outlines. No motion lines, no props, no grey checkerboard, no shadow, no text.
